decision.explanation: The question asks for the artist performing in 'Live at the El Rey'. The source documents and original cards identify five distinct works sharing this title or a very similar title ('Live at The El Rey', 'Live from the El Rey Theatre'), each performed by a different artist. D1 confirms Mutemath released a 'Live at the El Rey' EP. D2 lists 'Live at The El Rey' (2005) by Collide and 'Live at the El Rey' (2006 EP/film) by The Beatles. D4 confirms 'Live at the El Rey' (film) features Stephen Lynch. D5 confirms 'Live from the El Rey Theatre' (often referenced in the same context of El Rey performances) is by Jack's Mannequin. Since the prompt allows for distinct valid namesakes and complementary answers where competing assertions refer to different entities (different albums/DVDs with the same name), all five artists are retained as they correspond to distinct valid referents found in the source text.
